messages.text: For the Helix QBR — how do the Q1 cold-chain misses break down, warehouse vs carrier?

Perfect, that matches the dock utilization report. Using that for root cause.
Also — if Sales tries to add another cold-chain account, we do NOT have reefer capacity right now. Same docks.
